app.name: Linquo
app.sidebarNote: Your lessons stay with you. Learn anywhere, at your pace.
app.previewBody: Open the Tauri desktop or mobile app to save your provider, manage your database, and learn from local lessons.
app.footer: Made for the way you learn.
app.description: Learn at your own pace with personalized lessons, saved on your device for offline practice.

errors.nativeRequired: Open Linquo in the desktop or mobile app to access your local database.
errors.providerFormat: Enter a provider and model separated by a colon, for example ollama:llama3.2.
errors.emptyLibrary: Your library is empty. Generate a level check or import a database to get started.
errors.noLesson: No saved {{level}} lessons yet. Generate a lesson to add one to your offline library.
errors.providerRequired: Add a provider in settings to generate new exercises.
errors.databaseSize: The database must be smaller than 100 MB.
errors.unsupportedPair: Choose a language pair supported by this version of Linquo.

notices.imported: Database imported. Your learning is ready on this device.
notices.assessmentReady: Your level check is saved and ready. You can take it offline.
notices.generated_one: {{count}} new {{level}} exercise saved for offline practice.
notices.generated_other: {{count}} new {{level}} exercises saved for offline practice.

setup.title: A language. A little closer.
setup.description: Make language learning part of your everyday. Connect a model to create your lessons, then learn at your own pace—even offline.
setup.providerDescription: Choose the provider and model that will create your exercises.
setup.note: Your data. Your model. Your pace.

home.title: Small steps. New worlds.
home.description: A few minutes of practice. A little more confidence.
home.newDescription: A short level check helps your lessons meet you where you are.
home.heroDescription: Practice with the exercises in your library. No connection needed, just a little curiosity.
home.newHeroDescription: Try a selection of exercises, from everyday basics to more advanced language skills. We’ll use your answers to estimate your level.
home.partialCheck: Your check uses the levels in your library. Generate a full check for broader coverage.
home.artCaption: a whole new way to connect.
home.emptyDescription: Generate exercises or import a database. Everything you add will be available offline.
home.note: Learning is a practice, not a race. Make a little space for it.

summary.assessmentEyebrow: A starting point, not a limit
summary.title: A little practice. Real progress.
summary.assessmentDescription: {{proficiency}} in {{language}}. Your lessons can now follow your proficiency.
summary.description: Your answers have been saved. Come back whenever you’re ready for a little more.

generation.title: A fresh page of possibilities.
generation.description: Let your model prepare new exercises. They’re saved to your library automatically.
generation.lessonDescription: Fine-tune your next lesson in settings, or generate using your saved preferences.
generation.assessmentDescription: We’ll create two exercises at each CEFR level, A1 to C2. This uses up to six generation calls. Saved levels are reused when you retry.
generation.statusNote: You can practice without a connection after this finishes.
generation.tipDescription: Prepare a few lessons before a trip, your commute, or a quiet moment away from the internet.
generation.providerNote: Generation uses your configured provider. Local models work with your own running server.

settings.title: Your learning, your way.
settings.description: A few preferences to make your practice feel right.
settings.pairHelp: Available language pairs are provided by the app. Progress and lessons are tracked separately for each pair.
settings.providerHelp: Use a provider:model reference, such as openai:gpt-4o-mini or ollama:llama3.2.
settings.baseUrlHelp: The address of your running {{provider}} server.
settings.romanizationHelp: Reading support alongside learning-language text, where available.
settings.storageNote: Saved on this device in your app database, including the API key.
settings.databaseDescription: Import an existing Linquo database, or export a complete snapshot of your lessons, settings, and progress to your device. The export location is shown when it finishes.
settings.disconnectDescription: Remove the saved provider and API key from this device.

database.replaceDescription: Importing {{filename}} replaces your current lessons, progress, and settings with those in the file.

exercise.buildAnswer: Tap the words to build your answer
exercise.matchingHelp: Select a left tile, then its match on the right. Select a matched left tile to change it.
exercise.pauseAssessment: Your level check will restart next time. Complete it to save your starting level.
exercise.pausePractice: Your checked answers are saved. You can start another lesson anytime.
